title: Easier IED investigation and exact field copy
titleId: Investigasi IED lebih mudah dengan salin field yang tepat
summary: ARSAS 1.6.45 streamlines IEC 61850 engineering inspection: copy precise RCB and model properties in IED Browser, select and export multiple Event Log rows with familiar Excel-like gestures, and reuse Copy across engineering grids. This observational UI update leaves IEC protocol and control behavior unchanged.
summaryId: ARSAS 1.6.45 mempermudah investigasi IEC 61850: salin nilai RCB dan properti model yang tepat di IED Browser, pilih dan salin banyak baris Event Logs seperti Excel, serta gunakan Copy pada berbagai grid engineering. Perubahan UI observasional ini tidak mengubah protokol IEC atau perilaku kontrol.
highlights: IED Browser: right-click any visible property such as Report ID, RCB Name, DataSet reference or Control Block reference to copy its exact displayed value.
IED Browser: copy the field/object name, name + value, or all visible properties, while preserving the correct clicked-row identity after refresh.
Event Log: select contiguous full event rows by mouse drag or Shift+click; copy ranges via context menu or Ctrl+C.
Event Log: selection does not unexpectedly expand the event inspector during right-click or multi-row gestures.
Shared clipboard support remains available in Device Explorer, Live Values, Command Grid and other engineering tables.
highlightsId: IED Browser: klik kanan properti seperti Report ID, RCB Name, DataSet reference, atau Control Block reference untuk menyalin nilai tampilannya secara persis.
IED Browser: salin nama field/objek, pasangan nama + nilai, atau seluruh properti terlihat tanpa mengambil baris yang salah setelah refresh.
Event Logs: pilih beberapa baris event dengan click-drag atau Shift+click; salin melalui menu klik kanan atau Ctrl+C.
Event Logs: pemilihan banyak baris dan klik kanan tidak membuka panel detail secara tiba-tiba.
Copy bersama tetap tersedia pada Device Explorer, Live Values, Command Grid, dan tabel engineering lainnya.
improvements: The clipboard adapter is shared, bounded and read-only: no IEC MMS Read, Write, RCB takeover or Control action is triggered by a Copy operation.
Keyboard Ctrl+C and right-click target selection are consistent while WPF row virtualization and focused engineering-object selection remain intact.
User-accepted Windows pointer/keyboard workflows were reconciled through PRs #782, #783 and #784; canonical Windows and installer release gates passed for v1.6.45.
The public installer and portable single EXE share exact tagged source identity and published SHA-256 checksums, SPDX SBOM and provenance.
improvementsId: Adapter clipboard tetap bersama, berbatas, dan hanya baca: operasi Copy tidak memicu MMS Read, Write, pengambilalihan RCB, atau Control.
Ctrl+C dan pilihan target klik kanan konsisten tanpa merusak virtualisasi WPF maupun pilihan objek engineering.
Pengujian mouse/keyboard yang telah diterima pengguna direkonsiliasi melalui PR #782, #783 dan #784; build Windows dan installer v1.6.45 lulus gate resmi.
Installer dan portable single EXE publik berasal dari source bertag yang sama dengan SHA-256, SPDX SBOM, dan provenance terpublikasi.
knownLimitations: The SG7_BCU trace also recorded 4 BufOvfl indications and 28 SqNum discontinuities. These are not verified lost-event counts; lossless buffered SOE is not established.
Six-byte MMS BinaryTime has no clock-synchronization quality byte. Buffer classification uses corroborating evidence and does not certify IED clock quality.
Physical R7/R10 interoperability qualification and SCL/IID parity remain incomplete for the pinned ARIEC61850 trial engine; no universal device certification is implied.
Manual PurgeBuf destroys retained IED history. Use it only on an authorized, idle test BRCB after reviewing the consequences; ARSAS never runs it automatically.
Windows x64 installers are not Authenticode-signed; verify the published SHA-256. Raw GOOSE/SV capture needs approved Npcap, and control operations require an authorized procedure.
knownLimitationsId: Trace SG7_BCU juga mencatat 4 indikasi BufOvfl dan 28 diskontinuitas SqNum. Ini bukan jumlah event yang terbukti hilang; SOE buffer tanpa kehilangan belum terverifikasi.
MMS BinaryTime 6-byte tidak membawa byte kualitas sinkronisasi clock. Klasifikasi buffer memakai bukti gabungan dan bukan sertifikasi kualitas jam IED.
Kualifikasi interoperabilitas fisik R7/R10 dan paritas SCL/IID untuk engine ARIEC61850 trial yang dipin masih belum lengkap; tidak ada klaim sertifikasi semua perangkat.
PurgeBuf manual menghapus riwayat IED yang tersimpan. Gunakan hanya pada BRCB uji yang idle dan berizin setelah memahami akibatnya; ARSAS tidak pernah menjalankannya otomatis.
Installer Windows x64 belum memiliki tanda tangan Authenticode; verifikasi SHA-256. Capture GOOSE/SV memerlukan Npcap yang disetujui dan operasi control harus mengikuti prosedur berizin.

codeSigning.label: Not Authenticode-signed
codeSigning.detail: The current public Windows installer and portable binaries do not carry a commercial Authenticode publisher signature. Verify the published SHA-256 value before use. SmartScreen warnings are therefore possible and are not hidden from users.
codeSigning.detailId: Installer Windows dan portable EXE publik saat ini belum memiliki commercial Authenticode publisher signature. Verifikasi nilai SHA-256 yang dipublikasikan sebelum digunakan. Karena itu peringatan SmartScreen masih mungkin muncul dan status ini tidak disembunyikan dari user.
